title: Trade and International Business: Research & Analysis | CSIS
text:
Trade and International Business

Reciprocal tariffs, threats to global supply chains, and comparative manufacturing advantages have disrupted the established global trade system. CSIS scholars provide analysis and commentary on the international trading system and its institutions.

Resilience and Reform: U.S.-China Relations and the Global Economic Order

In this collection of survey results and essays from the U.S.-China Global Economic Order (GEO) Dialogue, participants examine how Chinese and international experts view the trade truce, export controls, WTO reform, and the future of the global economy.

One Year After Busan: Has China Kept Its Rare Earth Promises?

One year after Busan, China’s rare earth exports to the United States remain sharply below pre-restriction levels, even as global shipments hold steady. Beijing’s continued control over rare earth supplies raises the stakes for Trump-Xi meetings in Shenzhen and Miami.
